flux_evidence: A GitHub release four days after last_checked (v1.3.0, 2026-08-26) shipped a breaking DFR checkpoint-format change and removed a CLI flag the skill instructs users to pass; HF monthly downloads flipped in 2.5's favor within two and a half weeks; dense community quantization (MLX, INT8, FP8, NVFP4) activity continues weekly.

findings.claim: DFR runs the distilled sigma schedule on the full checkpoint, using the distilled LoRA (stage 1 half-res, stage 2 full-res with the distilled LoRA).
findings.reality: LTX-2 v1.3.0 (2026-08-26) changed this: release notes list under Changed, "Checkpoint Format: DFR now requires distilled checkpoint instead of full checkpoint plus LoRA," and under Removed, "Legacy checkpoint/LoRA flags." The full-checkpoint-plus-distilled-LoRA loading path the skill documents no longer applies.
findings.fix_hint: SKILL.md ~L213-215 ("DFR — DFRPipeline, 2.5 only") and ~L268 (stage-1 description); references/setup-and-workflows.md ~L209 ("DFR in detail") — update checkpoint-loading instructions to the distilled checkpoint directly, drop the full-checkpoint+distilled-LoRA framing and the now-removed legacy flags.

findings.claim: `--temporal-upsample-rounds {0,1,2}` is the DFR temporal-rounds flag and the native alternative to RIFE.
findings.reality: LTX-2 v1.3.0 (2026-08-26) release notes list `--num-generated-keyframes` and `--temporal-upsample-rounds` under Removed. A user following the skill's flag as written will hit an unrecognised-argument error on current ltx-pipelines.
findings.fix_hint: SKILL.md ~L215, ~L266, ~L270 and any other `--temporal-upsample-rounds` mentions — find the replacement flag/mechanism in the current ltx_pipelines CLI help and update all three call sites.

findings.claim: The ecosystem is still on 2.3: HF downloads favored 2.3 (1.58M vs 695k) as of 2026-08-22, used to justify defaulting new users to 2.3 in the variant selector.
findings.reality: As of 2026-09-09, Lightricks/LTX-2.5's HF card shows 1,644,796 downloads in the last month versus Lightricks/LTX-2.3's 1,181,828 — 2.5 has overtaken 2.3 on this axis. The Civitai LoRA-count side of the same claim (168 vs 3 on 2026-08-22) was not resampled this run (tag-based Civitai API queries did not return usable totals) and needs a follow-up check.
findings.fix_hint: SKILL.md variant selector ~L54 and two-bar bullet ~L347 — the download-count half of the "ecosystem hasn't followed" argument no longer holds; the LoRA-count half is still unverified this cycle, so soften the framing rather than flip it outright.

findings.claim: Replicate carries no ltx-2.5-pro and its pricing was not read (implying no 2.5 presence on Replicate at all).
findings.reality: Replicate's Lightricks page now lists "ltx-2.5-fast" (6.8K runs) alongside ltx-2.3-pro/fast — a 2.5 tier exists on Replicate, though still no ltx-2.5-pro. Pricing was not confirmed this run.
findings.fix_hint: SKILL.md task table ~L169 and references/setup-and-workflows.md ~L189 — add ltx-2.5-fast as a routing option; the "no 2.5 on Replicate" framing is now inaccurate for the fast tier.

findings.claim: Apple Metal support is contested / unresolved.
findings.reality: LTX-2 v1.3.0 (2026-08-26) release notes list a Fixed item: "macOS uv sync compatibility for non-CUDA torch wheels" — official engineering attention to macOS install is now happening, though this is packaging compatibility, not confirmation of working Metal inference or a reproduced benchmark.
findings.fix_hint: SKILL.md two-bar bullet ~L348 — note the packaging fix as movement without claiming Metal inference is resolved; still needs a reproduced macOS run to close.

new_techniques.what: A wave of community MLX conversions of LTX-2.5 has appeared on Hugging Face (mlx-community and multiple individual accounts): bf16, q4, q8, ditq8 and w4a8-convrot-int4 variants, letting the model run on Apple Silicon via MLX rather than native PyTorch/CUDA.
new_techniques.why_it_matters: This is the practical answer to Apple support right now — not Metal-backed PyTorch, but an MLX conversion path with real community uptake.
new_techniques.where_it_belongs: SKILL.md two-bar bullet ~L348 (platform support); references/setup-and-workflows.md (a macOS/Apple Silicon subsection)

new_techniques.what: v1.3.0 extended NVFP4 quantization support (introduced for Blackwell GPUs in v1.2.0) to Jetson Thor via a `110a` architecture target.
new_techniques.why_it_matters: Widens the low-VRAM/edge-hardware quantization story beyond desktop Blackwell cards, relevant to the contested VRAM-floor discussion.
new_techniques.where_it_belongs: references/setup-and-workflows.md optimization/quantization section; SKILL.md two-bar bullet ~L346 (VRAM floor)

new_techniques.what: v1.3.0 shipped `ltx_pipelines.dfr_mgpu`, a distributed multi-GPU DFR runner, alongside fixes for multi-GPU DFR tiling and temporal-boundary bugs.
new_techniques.why_it_matters: First official multi-GPU path for the DFR pipeline specifically, relevant for production setups scaling past a single card.

new_techniques.what: DFR can now finish 4K output via a tiled spatial epilogue (`--spatial-upscalings 2`) instead of denoising the full canvas in stage 2, changing the recommended path to 4K.
new_techniques.why_it_matters: Changes the mechanics of the highest-resolution DFR workflow the skill documents.

new_techniques.what: A detailed HF discussion reports LTX-2.5's Gemma-4 text encoder struggles with precise audio/lip-sync for singing avatars and music videos, recommending 2.3 for that use case specifically; the author notes recent nightly builds partially but inconsistently improve it.
new_techniques.why_it_matters: A named, use-case-specific regression versus 2.3 that the skill's version-selector guidance doesn't currently carve out.
new_techniques.where_it_belongs: SKILL.md variant selector ~L54-64 (add a music-video/singing-avatar caveat)

add.claim: v1.3.0 (2026-08-26) changed DFR to load the distilled checkpoint directly (no more full-checkpoint+distilled-LoRA) and removed `--temporal-upsample-rounds`/`--num-generated-keyframes`. The skill's DFR sections still describe the pre-v1.3.0 mechanics and flags.
add.check: Diff the current ltx_pipelines DFR CLI help and checkpoint-loading code against what SKILL.md documents; confirm whether the replacement flag for temporal upsampling has stabilized or is still moving.

amend.note: HF monthly downloads flipped: 2.5 now leads 2.3 (1,644,796 vs 1,181,828 on 2026-09-09). Civitai LoRA-count comparison (168 vs 3 on 2026-08-22) was not resampled this run — tag-based Civitai API queries returned no usable totals. Next check should resample Civitai counts specifically.

v1.3.0 (2026-08-26) fixed macOS uv-sync compatibility for non-CUDA torch wheels, and a large community MLX-quantization wave for Apple Silicon has appeared on HF — movement on the install/packaging side, but no reproduced native Metal inference benchmark or ROCm report was found this run.
